news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.7% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Earnings have declined by 4.8% per year over the past 5 years. news.body: After last week's 16% share price decline to ₹47.40, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 9.6x. Average trailing P/E is 21x in the Chemicals industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 22% over the past three years.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.39 (vs ₹1.06 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.39 (up from ₹1.06 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹444.7m (up 14% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹11.9m (up 31% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 2.7% (up from 2.3% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 58% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 1% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
